const key = Symbol('key');
const otherKey = Symbol('key');
function absent(value: {[key]: number} | {other: string}) {
  if (key in value) value.other.toUpperCase();
  else value[key].toFixed();
}
function identity(value: object) {
  if (key in value) console.log(value[otherKey]);
}
function optional(value: {[key]?: number} | {other: string}) {
  if (key in value) value[key].toFixed();
}
type Result = {kind: 'ok'; value: string} | {kind: 'error'; value: Error};
function wrongBranches(value: Result) {
  if (value['kind'] === 'ok') value.value.message;
  else value.value.toUpperCase();
}
function dynamicParameter(value: Result, property: 'kind') {
  if (value[property] === 'ok') value.value.toUpperCase();
}
function dynamicLet(value: Result) {
  let property = 'kind' as const;
  if (value[property] === 'ok') value.value.toUpperCase();
}
function tuple(value: ['ok', string] | ['error', Error]) {
  if (value[0] === 'ok') value[1].message;
  else value[1].toUpperCase();
}
type Combined = {id: number} & ({kind: 'ok'; value: string} | {kind: 'error'; value: Error});
function combined(value: Combined) {
  if (value.kind === 'ok') value.value.message;
  else value.value.toUpperCase();
}
type SymbolTagged = ({[key]: 'ok'} & {value: string}) | ({[key]: 'error'} & {value: Error});
function symbolTagged(value: SymbolTagged) {
  if (value[key] === 'ok') value.value.message;
}
function templateKeys(value: Result) {
  if (value[`kind`] === 'ok') value.value.message;
  if (value[`${'kind'}`] === 'ok') value.value.toUpperCase();
}
